encounters.notes: Root Approach: Washi-Hollow Monks flip to a blank gold-marked back when struck wrong. Glaze Erosion applies.
Lanterns stay harmless until cracked Crono's light lights them; they erase themselves on Break (the NULL lesson).
A seven-vertebra stag charging out of the white with only gold dust as warning; sheds two fawns at 50%.
Clear the smudges within 12 s or the party is Ink Blotted.
First Kirie Keeper: its two monks share a 10-plate shield that must Break before the Keeper can be shaved. 13 Kirie Scales.
Second Kirie Keeper, with an Ink-Eater spreading under the fight.
Third Kirie Keeper; sparing all three is Light, killing yields Prismatic Shards.
The climb to the Crown of Horns.
